description: This file defines utility functions and classes for security token management, Thunder plugin communication, and plugin activation within a C++ project, specifically related to Thunder framework and security configuration.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: A class for dispatching work asynchronously, with different base classes depending on compilation flags.

methods.name: getSecurityToken
methods.description: Retrieves a security token, caching it for subsequent calls.

methods.name: writeCurlResponse
methods.description: Callback for handling curl responses, appending data to a string stream.

methods.name: isThunderSecurityConfigured
methods.description: Checks if Thunder security subsystem is configured by querying a local service.

methods.name: getThunderControllerClient
methods.description: Creates and returns a Thunder plugin client with security token authentication.

methods.name: getServiceState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of a plugin service via its callsign.

methods.name: activatePlugin
methods.description: Activates a plugin identified by its callsign asynchronously.
